items.stem: 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

lines: G: Eric, I like your bag! It’s so cute.
B: Thanks, Yena. I made it from old jeans.
G: Really? That’s amazing!
B: We can make new things from old things. It’s called upcycling.
G: I’d like to try it. What can I do to start upcycling?
B: First, you can find something you don’t need.
G: Well, I have an old skirt at home.
B: Good. Then think about an item you want to make.
G: Oh, I want to make a pencil case.
B: Perfect. And don’t forget to wash the skirt before upcycling.
B: boy, G: girl

choices: Eric: I made it from old shirts.
Eric: We can make new things from new things.
Yena: I have an old skirt at school.
Yena: I want to make a pencil case.
Eric: Don’t forget to wash the skirt after upcycling.
items.explain: Oh, I want to make a pencil case. ① old jeans ② from old things ③ at home ⑤ before upcycling. 대화 문장에서 한 단어씩 바꿈.

items.stem: 어법이 맞는 문장은?
choices: Every students should recycle plastic bottles.
All the children was playing outside.
Each key opens a different door.
I heard my friend to talk on the phone.
All the furniture in the rooms are expensive.
items.explain: ① Every student ② were ④ talk/talking ⑤ is(셀 수 없는 명사). 학습지 p.43~44 문장 변형.
items.source: 선생님 제작 어법 문장 (학습지 p.42~44 each·every·all 수일치 · 지각동사)

items.stem: 대화의 흐름상 밑줄 (A)에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?

lines: B: I feel tired these days.
B: Once a week. I usually stay up late watching videos.
G: It’s important to get eight hours of sleep every night.
B: You’re right. I’ll try to go to bed earlier.
G: Great. Good sleep makes a big difference.
B: boy, G: girl

choices: How often do you get enough sleep, Sejun?
What can I do to start upcycling?
How often do you clean it?
Do you have a spending plan?
items.explain: Once a week. 로 답하므로 빈도를 묻는 How often ~? 오답은 범위 대화문·본문의 다른 문장.

items.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
items.box:
ⓐ I saw Sam laughing with his friends.
ⓑ Kelly heard someone to call her name.
ⓒ Trees will help cleaning the air.
ⓓ Mr. Kim felt the ground shaking.
ⓔ All the letters from my old friends make me happy.
ⓕ Let me read this paper airplane.
ⓖ She listened to a radio DJ to read a poem.
items.explain: 지각동사+목적어+동사원형/현재분사: ⓑ call(calling) ⓖ reading(read). ⓒ 준사역 help+동사원형(Trees will help clean the air.). ⓔ 5형식 make+목적어+형용사(수일치 all+복수). ⓕ 사역 let+동사원형. 원문: 학습지 p.45 F-2·3·4·5, p.43 B-12, L5 T1-A3, L6 T2-B.
items.source: 학습지 p.45 grammar 3-F 지각동사 · p.43 수일치 + 범위 대화문의 let/help 문장 (이전 시험 사역·5형식 연계)

box.title: Exciting Sports Day
lines: Woori Middle School held a sports day on October 2nd at the school playground. (A) One of the biggest events was the final soccer game between Class 1 and 3. (B) All the students came to cheer for the two classes. (C) Class 3 won the game, 3 to 2. (D) The game was so exciting. (E) Everyone had a great time!

items.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 운동회(축구 결승전)를 전하는 학교 신문 기사.

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 <보기>의 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: Jinwoo scored the winning goal and became the MVP of the game.

items.explain: 3반이 이겼다 → 결승골을 넣은 진우가 MVP → 경기가 흥미진진했다.

items.stem: 대화의 밑줄 (A)~(E) 중 윗글과 내용이 일치하지 <u>않는</u> 것은?

lines: Hajin: Do you remember? (A)<u>Woori Middle School held a sports day on October 2nd.</u>
Semi: Of course! (B)<u>One of the biggest events was the final soccer game between Class 1 and 3.</u>
Hajin: Right. (C)<u>All the students came to cheer for the two classes.</u>
Semi: (D)<u>Class 1 won the game, 3 to 2.</u>
Hajin: (E)<u>Jinwoo scored the winning goal and became the MVP of the game.</u>
Semi: Everyone had a great time!

items.explain: Class 3 won the game, 3 to 2. (대화의 밑줄은 본문 문장 그대로, (D)만 한 단어 바꿈)
items.source: L6 My Writing (교과서 기타 지문) · 밑줄 문장은 본문 그대로

items.stem: 대화를 읽고 답할 수 <u>없는</u> 질문은?

lines: G: Brian, how about having a picnic tomorrow?
B: Sounds good! What can we do to reduce waste at the picnic?
G: We can use reusable cups.
B: Right. What else?
G: Don’t forget to bring reusable forks and spoons.
B: Sure, no problem. See you tomorrow!
B: boy, G: girl

choices: 소풍에서 쓰레기를 줄이기 위해 그들은 무엇을 사용할 수 있는가?
items.explain: ① tomorrow ② reusable cups ③ reusable forks and spoons ⑤ the girl. ④ 장소는 언급 없음.

box.title: Student Survey: Are You a Saver or a Spender?
lines: What do you do with your money? Do you save it or spend it? (A)<u>We asked the following questions to 100 students from our school.</u> Let’s look at the results. Surprisingly, the survey showed that only 15 out of 100 students had a spending plan. The survey also showed what the students spent the most money on. (B)<u>Food was chosen by the largest number of students.</u> Transportation followed food. Also, (C)<u>80 percent of 3rd-year students saved money, but only 30 percent of 1st-year students saved money.</u>
A Special Message from the Principal
(F)<u>Money doesn’t grow on trees.</u> (G)<u>Planning your spending is very important!</u> (D)<u>Everyone need good spending habits.</u> Next week, (E)<u>every students will get a money diary.</u>

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 어법이 바르지 <u>않은</u> 것의 개수는?
items.explain: (D) Everyone needs (E) every student. (B) 수동태(1학기 문법) 맞음. 일부러 바꿔 쓴 문장.
items.source: L6 본문 2대목 Survey + Principal (교과서 본문) — (D)(E) 는 어법 문항용 변형

items.stem: 밑줄 (F)가 의미하는 바로 가장 알맞은 것은?
choices: 돈은 쉽게 얻을 수 없으니 신중하게 써야 한다.
나무를 심어서 돈을 벌 수 있다.
음식이 교통보다 돈이 더 많이 든다.
items.explain: 돈은 저절로 생기지 않는다 → 소비를 계획하라. 기출 10번(속담) 자리를 밑줄 의미 추론으로.

items.stem: 밑줄 (G)를 가주어 It으로 시작하는 문장으로 바꾸어 쓰시오. (4점)
items.answer: It is very important to plan your spending.
items.explain: 동명사 주어를 to부정사 진주어로 바꾸고 가주어 It 을 앞에 둔다.
items.source: L6 본문 2대목 Principal · 학습지 p.35 가주어 it

items.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 순서대로 바르게 배열한 것은?

lines: G: We need to save energy to slow down global warming.
G: And don’t forget to turn off the light when you leave a room.
B: boy, G: girl
(A) We can use the air conditioner less often.
(B) Yeah. That would save a lot of energy.
(C) You’re right. What can we do to save energy?

items.explain: 방법 묻기 → We can ~ → Yeah, That would save ~. (서답형 7과 자료가 겹치지 않도록 1-A1 로 바꿈)

items.stem: 어법상 <u>틀린</u> 것은?
choices: Every seat was taken at the concert.
All the lights are turned off at 11 p.m.
Each visitor will receive a gift.
All of his money were stolen.
Every house on this street was painted last year.
items.explain: money 는 셀 수 없는 명사 → All of his money was stolen. 학습지 p.43 A 문장.
items.source: 학습지 p.43 L6 grammar 1-A each·every·all 수일치

items.stem: 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 의미상 <u>어색한</u> 문장은?
choices: We walked by the <u>canal</u> and saw some boats.
The dark forest looked <u>scary</u> at night.
I sold my old bike at the <u>flea market</u>.
The speaker <u>increased</u> his speech for the children.
Earth is the third <u>planet</u> from the Sun.
items.explain: The speaker slowed down his speech for the children.

lines: Hello, I’m Suin from Korea. Every summer, it (A)( rain / rains ) a lot here. Sometimes, we have floods and they are really scary. The situation in Venice must be scary, too. I’ve never (B)( been / gone ) to Venice, but I have seen many beautiful pictures of it. I talked to my friends about the floods in your city. We wanted to help Venice, so we started the 3R campaign. The 3Rs are Recycle, Reuse, and Reduce. Now, many students at my school are doing these three things every day. (C)( It / That ) is important to do our part for Venice. (D)______________________!

items.stem: 수인과 친구들이 3R 캠페인을 시작한 이유는?
items.explain: We wanted to help Venice, so we started the 3R campaign.

items.stem: (A)~(C)에 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: (A) it rains (B) have been to(경험 — 1학기 현재완료) (C) 가주어 It.
items.source: L5 본문 3대목 Suin · 학습지 p.35 가주어 it

items.stem: 밑줄 (D)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: Together, we can make a difference
We will do better from now on
Good sleep makes a big difference
items.explain: 우리의 역할을 하는 것이 중요 → 함께 변화를 만들 수 있다. 오답은 범위 본문·대화문의 다른 문장.

items.stem: <보기>의 문장 중 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것의 개수는?

box.title: <보기>
lines: - Every summer, it rains a lot in Korea.
- Sometimes, they have floods in Korea and they are really scary.
- Suin has been to Venice, and she has seen many beautiful pictures of it.
- Suin and her friends wanted to help Venice, so they started the 3R campaign.
- The 3Rs are Recycle, Reuse, and Reduce.
- Now, few students at Suin’s school are doing these three things every day.
- Suin thinks the situation in Venice must be scary, too.

items.explain: 일치 5개. 불일치: has been to Venice(never been), few students(many students). 본문 문장에서 한 단어씩 바꿈.

items.stem: <보기>의 어떤 빈칸에도 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 단어는?

box.title: <보기>
lines: - The company will ________ its sales next year.
- We should ________ the use of plastic.
- I always ________ the other side of the paper.
- The water level can ________ after a huge rain.

items.explain: increase / reduce / reuse / rise. 학습지 예문 그대로.

box.title: Club News: Spreading Cheer Everywhere
lines: Let’s meet Fly High, our school’s cheerleading club. The club started from an idea of one student two years ago. Now, (F)<u>there is 10 girls and 6 boys in the club.</u> Each member has a special energy. Do you remember the recent school basketball game? After two quarters, (A)<u>our team</u> was losing by 20 points. During halftime, Fly High came on the court. (B)<u>They</u> performed wonderfully. They flipped in the air and made a human pyramid. Then they shouted, “Never give up!” And guess what? Our team won the game in the end. Jina, the captain of the club, said, “(C)<u>I</u> can flip in the air because I trust my club members. (H)<u>저는 관중들이 응원하고 소리치는 것을 볼 때 자랑스럽습니다.</u> Fly High is the best part of (D)<u>my</u> middle school life!” (G)<u>You can watch Fly High to do their performance at the school festival next week.</u> Come and feel (E)<u>their</u> energy!

items.stem: <보기> 중 밑줄 (A)~(E)와 지시하는 대상이 바르게 연결된 것을 모두 고른 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: ⓐ (A) our team – Fly High
ⓑ (B) They – Fly High
ⓒ (C) I – Jina
ⓓ (D) my – Jina
ⓔ (E) their – Fly High

items.explain: (A) our team 은 학교 농구팀(20점 차로 지고 있던 팀)이지 Fly High 가 아니다.

items.stem: <보기>의 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 윗글에 있지 <u>않은</u> 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: ⓐ to believe that someone or something is reliable, good, honest, etc
ⓑ the break between the two halves in sports like football and basketball
ⓒ an athlete who is chosen to be the leader of a team
ⓓ to move something down or make it less
ⓔ to turn (something) over by throwing it up in the air with a quick movement

items.explain: ⓐ trust ⓑ halftime ⓒ captain ⓔ flip 은 본문에 있음. ⓓ lower 는 없음.

items.stem: 밑줄 (F)와 (G)를 어법에 맞게 고쳐 문장 전체를 다시 쓰시오. (6점, 각 3점)
items.answer: (1) Now, there are 10 girls and 6 boys in the club. (2) You can watch Fly High doing their performance at the school festival next week. (do 도 인정)
items.explain: (F) there are + 복수 (G) 지각동사 watch + 목적어 + 동사원형/현재분사. 본문 문장을 일부러 틀리게 바꿔 실었다.
items.source: L6 본문 1대목 Fly High · 학습지 p.42 수일치 · 지각동사

items.stem: <보기>에서 필요한 단어만 골라 (H)의 해석에 맞게 영어 문장을 완성하시오. (단, 필요한 경우 형태를 바꿀 수 있음.) (4점)

box.title: <보기>
lines: when, I, see, the crowd, cheering, screaming, feel, proud, and, to, watch

items.answer: When I see the crowd cheering and screaming, I feel proud. (cheer and scream 도 인정)
items.explain: 지각동사 see + 목적어 + 현재분사/동사원형.

items.stem: <보기>의 우리말과 일치하도록 괄호 안의 단어를 활용하여 지각동사를 포함한 문장을 완성하시오. (6점, 각 3점)

box.title: <보기>
lines: (1) 나는 Sam이 그의 친구들과 웃고 있는 것을 보았다. (see, laugh)
(2) Kelly는 누군가 그녀의 이름을 부르는 것을 들었다. (hear, call)

items.answer: (1) saw Sam laughing (laugh) (2) heard someone call her name (calling)
items.explain: 지각동사 + 목적어 + 동사원형/현재분사. 학습지 문장 그대로.
items.source: 학습지 p.45 L6 grammar 3-F 지각동사 2·5번 문장 그대로

items.stem: 조건에 맞게 문장을 완성하시오. (4점)

lines: <보기> the, more, healthier, vegetables, you, eat, will, become
Dr. Kim: First, eat lots of vegetables. ________________________________.

condition: 조건 1. <보기>에 주어진 단어를 모두 사용할 것.
조건 2. 「the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 …」을 사용할 것.
items.answer: The more vegetables you eat, the healthier you will become.
items.explain: 「the 비교급 + 주어 + 동사 ~, the 비교급 + 주어 + 동사 …」 학습지 p.37 B-(1).
items.source: 학습지 p.37 L5 grammar 3-B the 비교급

items.stem: 소녀가 소년에게 책상을 얼마나 자주 청소하는지 빈도를 묻는 대화문이 되도록 밑줄 (A)에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오. (4점)

lines: G: Where’s my science book, Eric?
B: It’s on my desk.
B: I clean it once a month.
G: Oh, no! It’s important to keep your desk tidy.
B: boy, G: girl

items.answer: How often do you clean it
items.explain: 빈도 묻기: How often do you ~?

items.stem: 대화를 읽고 조건에 맞게 답하시오. (12점, 각 3점)

lines: G: The air is terrible today.
B: Yeah. The sky looks gray. (A)<u>우리가 대기 오염을 줄이기 위해 무엇을 할 수 있을까?</u>
G: (B)<u>우리는 나무를 더 많이 심을 수 있어.</u>
B: Right. Trees will help clean the air.
G: (C)<u>그리고 가까운 곳에는 자전거를 타거나 걸어가는 걸 잊지 마.</u>
B: Okay. (D)<u>우리가 나무를 더 많이 심을수록, 공기는 더 신선해져.</u>
B: boy, G: girl

condition: 조건 1. 밑줄 (A)~(C)는 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 영작할 것.
조건 2. 밑줄 (D)는 「the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 …」과 괄호 안의 말(much, trees, plant, fresh, get)을 사용하여 영작할 것.
items.answer: (A) What can we do to reduce air pollution? (B) We can plant more trees. (C) And don’t forget to ride your bike or walk to nearby places. (D) The more trees we plant, the fresher the air gets.
items.explain: (A) 방법 묻기 (B)(C) 대화문 그대로 (D) the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 … (학습지 p.37 뒷면 환경 실천 문장 그대로).
items.source: L5 Listen & Speak 1-A3 (교과서 대화문 그대로) · 학습지 p.37 뒷면 the 비교급 (서답형 7과 겹치던 1-A1 은 11번으로)
